heading: Combination with other extensions
text:
### Combination with other extensions [LNRE.2.2]

`regex: false` combines with any other setting. Interactions:

| With `regex: false` and | Effect |
|---|---|
| `linear_scan: false` | [LNLS.3.7]'s regex `capacity` bound is vacuously satisfied — no regex exists to bound. |
| `realtime: true` | [LNLS.2.3]'s enforcement of a regex `capacity` bound is likewise vacuous. Independently, a `realtime` deployment on a regex-less build ([LNRE.4]) gets both the RT allocation guarantees and the smallest image. |
| `logical: false` | No interaction; orthogonal constraints. |
| `dynamic_ttl: true` | No interaction; orthogonal constraints. |
